official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
CinAI connects ChatGPT to your CinAI account on cinai.tv. Ask for an image, a short video clip or a voiceover: CinAI shows the models your account can use, checks with you before it starts a generation, runs it and shows the finished files in a result card.

For larger projects CinAI can also build a Canvas (connected image, video, audio and editing steps you can open and rerun on cinai.tv), stage 3D World scenes with characters, cameras and lights, or hand a whole brief to the CinAI agent and report its progress and questions back to you.

You need a CinAI account. CinAI only works with the files, canvases, 3D worlds and tasks in the account you connect.
